description: Hands the repository's private pothos contract to every skill at session start, so third-party skills get their configuration without files in the repository, names the folder where the repository's retro findings go, keeps agents from merging pull requests or adding the auto-merge label outside the merge gate's person-authorized step, assigns every pull request a session opens to the person who opened it, and fast-forwards a plugin loaded in place from a git checkout to its remote's default branch.
